title: Quilt Manifest
description: Executable manifest schema for Quilt sheets. All extension fields are optional to preserve backward compatibility with simple value/formula sheets. Extension fields let planners and runtimes treat sheets as first-class artifacts with declared inputs, outputs, pre/postconditions, rollback, resource hints, and provenance.

version.description: Semver version of this manifest. Recommended for run traces and reproducibility.

description.description: Free-text description of what this sheet does.

entrypoint.description: Optional. If the sheet is invoked by an external runner, this is the cell id that runs first. Defaults to a topological sort of the dependency graph.

inputs.description: Declared input cells (or external artifacts) this manifest needs to run.

name.description: Local name to bind the input to.

uri.description: Quilt URI, e.g. quilt://ml/datasets/staged:latest or quilt://cells/data.staged

outputs.description: Declared output cells (or external artifacts) this manifest produces.

preconditions.description: Conditions that must be true before this manifest can run.

uri.description: For artifact_exists: the Quilt URI to check.

cell.description: For cell_ready: the cell id that must be in 'ready' state.

expr.description: For expr: a JavaScript expression evaluated in the engine context; must return truthy.

postconditions.description: Conditions that must be true after the manifest runs successfully.

rollback.description: How to undo side-effects if this manifest fails.

type.description: Rollback strategy. 'manifest' invokes another sheet. 'cell_set' restores prior cell values. 'none' is a no-op (only valid for read-only manifests).

manifest_id.description: For 'manifest': the id of the rollback sheet.

cells.description: For 'cell_set': the list of cell ids whose prior values should be restored.

resource_hints.description: Hints for the runtime about hardware, timing, and isolation.

network.description: Network policy for cell evaluators that touch the outside world.

model_requirements.description: For sheets that contain AI cells, hints for the model adapter layer.

llm_context_tokens.description: Minimum context window the model adapter must provide.

min_accuracy.description: Minimum benchmark score the model must achieve (advisory).

provenance_tags.description: Free-form tags used by planners and search to find relevant manifests.

irreversible.description: If true, the manifest declares it cannot be rolled back. Planners must require human approval before executing.
